report_name: New Linux Kernel Flaws Disclosed, Including Potential DoS

vulnerabilities.name: Linux Kernel NFSD Infinite Loop Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: A flaw in the Linux kernel's Network File System (NFS) server daemon (NFSD) can cause an infinite loop during layout state revocation, leading to a denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-17434
vulnerabilities.description: A remotely exploitable, improper authorization vulnerability in the handleAddMcpServer function of the nanocoai NanoClaw framework.

vulnerabilities.name: NousResearch hermes-agent Improper Access Control
vulnerabilities.description: An improper access control vulnerability in the SimpleX Gateway Authorization component of the NousResearch hermes-agent platform related to the contactId argument.
